name: Dr. Wellington Nkemadu
title: Founder
bio:
Dr. Wellington Nkemadu is a passionate youth development advocate and founder of Mary Gold, an organization registered by the Corporate Affairs Commission of Nigeria. His dedication to empowering young people drives Mary Gold's vision of building capable, confident, and responsible future leaders.

He obtained a B.A. in History (2nd Class Upper Division) from the University of Port Harcourt, where he received the Subject Prize in History and Diplomatic Studies and Professor Nwanna Nzewunwa's Memorial Prize.

In 2005, he was employed by the Independent Corrupt Practices and Other Related Offences Commission (ICPC) as an Investigator. While at the ICPC, he obtained a Master's degree in Law Enforcement and Criminal Justice from Ahmadu Bello University, Zaria. He also obtained a Senior Executive Certificate in Institutional Integrity Management from the University of Hong Kong.

Dr. Nkemadu has twenty years' experience and expertise in the investigation of corruption, bribery, money laundering, illicit financial flows (IFF), employment and admission racketeering, project tracking, and other related offences.

He served the ICPC in various strategic roles, including Investigator and Team Leader in General Investigations; Head of Special Task Forces; Coordinator of training for ICPC recruits from 2012 to 2023; and Prosecution Witness in several cases across the country.

He served as the Chief Security Officer of the Commission for six years, responsible for developing and implementing security protocols at the Headquarters and State offices.

He holds a Graduate Membership of the Nigerian Institute of Management, is an Associate Member of the Association of Certified Fraud Examiners, a Fellow of the Institute of Corporate Administration of Nigeria, and a Member of the Nigerian Army Resource Centre (mnarc).

Dr. Wellington Nkemadu retired from the ICPC after years of dedicated service on November 10, 2025. He is married with children, and enjoys travelling, reading, and watching documentaries.
